C A R E E R S Y N O P S I S
With 14+ years of professional experience, I specialize in project management, operational transformation, and leading teams of 20 to 40 members across the MENA region. My 5.5 years in project management have been marked by effective forecasting and shrinkage significant efficiency gains, and I've also worked in the 3rd and 2nd line of defense.
control,
contributing
to
·  Operational  transformation  across  KYC,  Screening,  and  AML  processes,
·  Developed  and  presented  comprehensive  Management  Information  System
My background includes KYC checks, audits, and ensuring compliance with regulators like the CBUAE, OCC, FCA, BaFin. I excel in due diligence, adapting to the unique risks of clients in the UAE, US, UK, and DE. My expertise also covers verifying client data from sources such as Lexis Nexis and Bankers Almanac.
I am committed to driving strategic growth and maintaining regulatory standards through my experience in operational transformation and project execution.

W O R K E X P E R I E N C E
Ernst & Young, Dubai (Jan 2025 till date) Manager (KYC & AML) · Directed project management for KYC operations in the UAE, ensuring compliance with local banking regulations and standards set by the Central Bank of the UAE.

Recently worked with one of the UAE's major banks, where I managed a team of 200 people and successfully delivered the project.
Developed and presented comprehensive MIS reports. ·
Evaluated and documented the approval or rejection of compliance cases, providing detailed feedback and recommendations for process enhancements.
Ernst & Young, Bangalore (December 2021 till Jan 2025) Manager (KYC & AML) · Directed project management for KYC operations in compliance with banking standards set by the Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE), ensuring adherence to local regulations.
Operational transformation across KYC, Screening, and AML processes, aligning with CBUAE guidelines to enhance efficiency and compliance
Developed and presented comprehensive Management Information System (MIS) reports that reflect CBUAE KYC requirements and operational metrics.

Leveraged 14+ years in banking and consulting, focusing on KYC and Transaction Monitoring, with a strong emphasis on compliance with CBUAE regulations.
Oaknorth Bank, Gurugram (June 2021 till December 2021) Senior Associate (Onboarding)

Perform loan booking operations in line with UK banking norms (KYC/Due diligence/AML).

Perform in life loan management activities within the available systems pertaining to Syndication, Agency, Bilateral Loan operations.

Review Legal documents in terms of completeness and plausibility and Review & sign-off on legal documents
Manage Payment operations to process payments to external parties · Query and task management by Loan and customer type.
UBS, Hyderabad (May, 2019 till June 21) KYC Authorized officer (Manager)

Lead the team on matters related to AML matters, KYC on-boarding, working with the Front line Origination Units to ensure all new clients are on-boarded correctly.

Ensure team performs active due diligence on clients, conducts quality assurance of customer AML KYC profiles of all risk ratings prepared by Front line Origination Units.

Keep abreast of new KYC policies, regulations, and requirements and implement new processes into the teams review processes.

Focus on the assurance of quality and consistency in Client Due Diligence standards in accordance to the prevailing requirements; and within stipulated timeframe across adoption locations.

Ensure the team has appropriate level of training on AML KYC/On-boarding matters to perform the role effectively.

·  Daily assessment of SWIFT and AML reports relating to potential suspicious
PWC-SDC, Bangalore (October 2017 till May 2019) KYC SME
·
Creating and modifying addendums and KOP/DTP as per recent regulatory requirements like FinCEN & FATCA (US), MIFID (UK&DE) and changes.
·
Liaising with policy team to make changes or updating Kop & DTPs;
Training new joiners or Refresher trainings, to make them operationally ready on the new Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Client (KYC) policy of the organization, as well as conducting refresher trainings for trained staff;

Providing Solutions & directions to IT teams for On boarding & product system enhancements;
Credit Suisse, Pune (September 2016 till September 2017) Compliance Analyst
AML Transaction Monitoring: · Monitoring transaction to identify potential money laundering risk, obtaining proper document to justify the transaction purpose and information available with the other tools like: Mantas, NTPA.
Monitoring the entire Watch-list listed names that have done the transaction above the set threshold.
Daily assessment of SWIFT and AML reports relating to potential suspicious activity. Analyze high risk wire transaction activity and recommend SAR filing for MLRO in case of potential Money Laundering. Collect documentary proof and build and maintain case files for transactions deemed suspicious.


DBOI Global Services Private Limited, Jaipur (July 2013 till September 2016) Process Analyst
·

· ·
Review and adhere to DB Global KYC Policy & AML policies & procedure Review completeness of a client's KYC (Know Your Customers) i.e. documentation/information and identifying missing documentation/information that needs to be obtained. Ensured compliance with all regulatory requirements, including Anti Money Laundering (AML) regulations such as USA PATRIOT ACT, BSA, FATCA, FCPA, OFAC Sanctions etc., Performing AML screening searches Performing QA (internal QC & 6 eye checks) Ensure KYC reviews are in accordance with all the prevailing regulatory guidelines, i.e. USA Patriot Act, 3rd EU MLD, MIFID Classification, and Deutsche Bank’s internal AML policies. Also, to ensure completion of pipeline on time and with the highest standards of quality.
